science_claim: Decentralized self-selection plus capability heterogeneity and fit/stand-down on a READY task belt; report trade-offs, not universal superiority

closure_rules.real_executable_work: Full ML DAG and repository repair each independently container-verified; all unsuccessful work included
closure_rules.decision_locus: Identical-input no-fault matched replay and coordinator-only/shared-store fault controls; live comparison reported as operational effect
closure_rules.statistical_unit: repository project for repair; ML corpus clustering reported separately
closure_rules.uncertainty: project-level paired intervals and source/corpus sensitivity; no equivalence or population claim merely from more API calls
closure_rules.monetary_cost: claim only after complete billed currency/request reconciliation; otherwise null and use tokens/provider-reported units separately
closure_rules.stop: all frozen eligible blocks run and audited or eligibility target fails; never extend based on effect sign
closure_rules.manuscript: IEEE and AJSTR reflect audited results, negative outcomes, limitations, and advisor RQ1/RQ2 scope
